curriculum.title: Cambridge Primary English
curriculum.note: Objective codes and wording are taken verbatim from the Stage 3 pages of the Cambridge Primary English 0844 Curriculum Framework, which is in the Primary 1 English folder on Google Drive and covers all six stages. The Primary 3 folder holds only a scanned resource pack with no text layer, so the units follow the genres the framework recommends for Stage 3: real life stories, myths and legends, adventure stories, poetry, plays, letters, non-chronological reports and instructions.
